data.name: iNKillerPlus
data.subtitle: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
data.localizedDescription: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.
data.versionDescription:
Instagram 448.0.0 | Instagram_448.0_iNKillerPlus_5.2

• Fixes a possible crash on rootless JB
- Add alternative icon to jailbreak since iG include the icon inside the app
- Fixes show app icon in settings for ios 26 - 27 as was disabled in previous versions
- Fixes show email open in profiles or copied text to detect emails automaticlly
- Fixes profile bio long press to copy detect email and links
- Fixes read DM icon
- Fixes user exception for direct message
- Add full compatibility with IG v445+
- Updated base IPA to Instagram v448.0
